body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Motorola introduced its smartphone 'Droid' on Android 2.0 at CES 2010, featuring free Google Map Navigation Beta, 5MP camera and DVD video.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
